title: PPK regional COGS snapshot and ops recommendations (working)
content:
Sheet: PPK regional COGS snapshot (working)

Purpose:
- Provide a compact per-model, per-region PPK (price-per-kilo-tokens) COGS breakdown and a short ops playbook for immediate wins. This is a working export for stakeholder review (eng/product/finance).

Legend / shorthand:
- PPK = price per 1,000 tokens (USD).
- COGS components: compute (GPU amortized), network egress, storage & KV cache amortized, infra overhead (monitoring, control plane), support allocation.
- Latency slices: p50 (low-latency tier), p90 (mid), p99 (tail-sensitive) — routing and batching behavior differ by slice.

ASSUMPTIONS (baseline scenario - Medium load):
- GPU hourly blended cost: us-west $2.75/hr, eu-north $3.10/hr, ap-sin $4.30/hr (includes infra margins).
- Effective tokens/sec per GPU (avg across request mix): small models 2000 tok/s, mid 800 tok/s, large 220 tok/s.
- Average token length per request: 60 tokens (prompt+response average).
- Bandwidth egress cost included only for non-cached responses: $0.0008 per 1k tokens in us-west, +15% eu, +40% ap.
- Cache hit reduces compute tokens by 35% on average (prefix+KV reuse).
- Overhead allocation: 8% of compute COGS.

TABLE (selected rows, numbers are illustrative):
Columns: model_family | region | model_size | p50_COGS_PPK | p90_COGS_PPK | p99_COGS_PPK | retail_price_PPK (current) | margin_p90 | notes
1) redwood-7b | us-west | 7B | $0.45 | $0.48 | $0.62 | $1.20 | 60% | high batching potential, cache-friendly
2) redwood-13b | us-west | 13B | $0.62 | $0.69 | $0.95 | $1.60 | 56% | modest cache gains, use quantized variant for low-cost tier
3) open-30b | eu-north | 30B | $1.40 | $1.60 | $2.25 | $3.00 | 47% | tail-heavy; reserve capacity recommended for predictability
4) llm-x70 | ap-sin | 70B | $3.10 | $3.55 | $5.10 | $6.00 | 43% | high egress in AP; consider regional remapping
5) reranker-lite | us-west | small | $0.08 | $0.09 | $0.12 | $0.20 | 55% | cheap, profitable - surface as default for ranking workloads

Scenario columns explanation:
- p50_COGS_PPK: assumes optimal batching and KV cache behavior for latency-sensitive p50 traffic.
- p90_COGS_PPK: realistic operating point with mixed batching and partial cache reuse. This is the primary cost baseline.
- p99_COGS_PPK: includes extra overheads from autoscaling churn, smaller effective batches, and fallbacks to higher-capacity variants.

Short formula notes (textual):
- compute_ppk ~= (gpu_hour_cost / tokens_per_hour) * 1000 * (1 + overhead_pct) * quant_factor
- tokens_per_hour = tokens_per_second * 3600 (tokens/sec is model dependent and workload-profile dependent)
- quant_factor = 0.8..1.2 depending on quantization and memory bandwidth (lower for 4-bit modes)
- effective_ppk_with_cache = compute_ppk * (1 - cache_reduction_pct) + egress_ppk + storage_amp_ppk

Observed sensitivities (from simulated microbench):
- 1) tokens/sec variance: small models: +/-20% across request mix drives PPK change of ~15%.
- 2) cache hit rate: +10pp hit rate => 6–9% PPK reduction on mid models, up to 18% on large models.
- 3) regional GPU price delta: AP (x1.55) => ~30–45% higher final PPK after egress and overhead.

Ops recommendations (quick win list):
- A: Route best-effort, non-latency traffic to cheaper region where legal/compliance allows (map by customer tenant tier). Threshold: use regional remap when expected p90_COGS difference > 20% and latency delta < 120ms.
- B: Introduce an automatic "quantized-fallback" variant for >13B models in hosted-api pricing: users hit highest latency  (p99) triggers fallback to quantized endpoint (saves ~25–35% PPK at cost of minor quality delta).
- C: Aggressive prefix KV caching pilot for chat workloads: rollout to top-20 customers with structured prompts; target +25–40pp hit rate uplift.
- D: Batching policy: raise batch window by +10ms for p90 traffic in dedicated pools where SLO allows; expected PPK drop ~8%.
- E: Reserved capacity trigger: move models with >5k QPS and >60% utilization in a region to Dedicated pricing path to reduce effective GPU blended cost by ~18% (contract permitting).

Pricing experiments to run (A/B candidates):
1) New PPK tier: "quantized-saver" at 0.85 * retail_price for qualifying models and with explicit quality caveat; measure churn and conversion.
2) Latency-tiered discounts: 5% discount for customers who opt-in to p90-only (no hard p50 SLA) across chosen endpoints.

Open questions & risks:
- Quality delta quantification for quantized-fallback across different prompt types (need eval harness per customer cohort).
- Legal/regulatory limits for routing customer traffic across regions (finance/legal check required).
- Billing model alignment for multi-region responses (when prompt in EU, model served in US).

Next steps (short backlog):
- 1) Eng: instrument per-tenant cache-hit and tokens/sec metric in console by 2024-12-20 (owner: Marco).
- 2) Product: sketch A/B experiment for quantized-saver tier and pricing copy by 2024-12-15 (owner: Aisha).
- 3) Solutions Eng: pick top 5 customers for KV caching pilot; run 6-week pilot (owner: Samir).
- 4) Finance: create a reconciliation report template linking billing PPK vs measured COGS_PPK by region (owner: Jing).

Appendix: quick CSV export (paste to sheet) - columns: model,region,p50_ppk,p90_ppk,p99_ppk,retail_ppk,notes

Comments: keep this export tightly focused on the ops playbook — more formalized unit econ models live in the cost-workbench workbook (linked). This sheet is intentionally opinionated and operationally actionable."
